verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a 3D rendering engine whose ecosystem includes interactive tools such as the Playground editor and Inspector, so an AI assistant that consumes MCP servers is conceivable and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Babylon.js or its tools acting as an MCP client or consuming tools from MCP servers. The only MCP-related probe concerns the absence of MCP servers, which is the opposite role and earns no credit here.
